title: Analysis of Small Silicon Samples by Glow Discharge Mass Spectrometry
author: Modanese, Arnberg, et al.

steps.title: Select appropriate silicon sample size
steps.instruction: Choose silicon pieces that are 20–70 mm in diameter, less than 40 mm high, and ensure the sputtered area (8 mm diameter) will be fully covered by the sample.

steps.title: Prepare silicon wafer mask
steps.instruction: Laser‑cut and chemically clean silicon wafer pieces to serve as thin masks.

substeps.instruction: Cut a 30 mm × 30 mm square from a mono‑ or multicrystalline Si wafer (thickness 145 µm or 300 µm).
Laser‑cut a central hole of 6 mm, 8 mm or 10 mm diameter (8 mm matches the anode flow‑tube).
Etch the mask to remove laser residues:
‑ Clean in RCA‑1 solution (H₂O : NH₃ : H₂O₂ = 5 : 1 : 1) for 10 min.
‑ Clean in RCA‑2 solution (H₂O : HCl : H₂O₂ = 5 : 1 : 1) for 10 min.
Store the etched mask in a clean box and handle it only with gloves.
Optional: measure surface roughness (0.11 for 145 µm mask, 0.16 for 300 µm mask) along a 5 mm line with 12 µm step resolution.

steps.title: Prepare tantalum sheet mask
steps.instruction: Laser‑cut and clean high‑purity Ta‑W alloy sheets to serve as reusable masks.

substeps.instruction: Cut a 25 mm × 25 mm square from a Ta‑W sheet (thickness 140–170 µm).
Laser‑cut an 8 mm diameter central hole (matches the anode flow‑tube).
Etch the mask to remove cutting and production contaminants:
‑ Immerse in chromic‑acid solution (0.1 mol L⁻¹ K₂Cr₂O₇ dissolved in H₂SO₄) for 10 min at room temperature (or until cleaning is sufficient).
‑ Rinse thoroughly with abundant de‑ionised water.
Drill the inner side of the laser‑cut hole with a clean diamond tip to smooth the edge.
Store the cleaned mask in a clean box and handle it only with gloves.
Optional: record surface roughness (≈0.5) measured with the same procedure as for Si wafers.

steps.title: Center mask on anode and mount sample
steps.instruction: Manually centre the prepared mask on the anode using the custom plastic centring tool, place the silicon sample beneath it, then fasten the sample holder as usual and mount the assembly on its support.

steps.title: Run GDMS analysis with standard parameters
steps.instruction: Perform direct‑current glow‑discharge mass spectrometry using the same discharge parameters normally employed for bulk silicon analysis (no mask), ensuring the instrument reaches vacuum with the mask in place.
